title: My Flashcards
text:
I have a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on one side. The other side has the meaning. I use them every day.

Today I study ten new words. I read the word, then I say it out loud. My sister helps me with the cards. We have fun together.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
How many new words does the writer study today?
How does the writer probably feel about flashcards?
What can we guess about studying with the sister?
options: It is fun for both of them

vocabulary.definition: small cards with a word on one side and its meaning on the other
units of language that have a meaning
a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Eu tenho uma caixa de cartões de estudo. Cada cartão tem uma palavra de um lado. O outro lado tem o significado. Eu uso os cartões todos os dias.
Hoje eu estudo dez palavras novas. Eu leio a palavra e depois digo em voz alta. Minha irmã me ajuda com os cartões. Nós nos divertimos juntas.
